sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, channel, category, SUM(revenue) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS jumlah_order, SUM(units) AS units FROM read_csv_auto(?) GROUP BY month, channel, category ORDER BY month, channel, category
SELECT strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS bulan, SUM(revenue) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS jumlah_order FROM read_csv_auto(?) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan
